mapper.insert: INSERT INTO park_review ( park_id, mem_id, review_content, rating ) VALUES ( #{parkId}, #{memId}, #{reviewContent}, #{rating} )
INSERT INTO review_photo ( review_id, file_path, original_name, img_order ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{filePath}, #{originalName}, #{imgOrder} )
mapper.select:
SELECT r.review_id, r.park_id, r.mem_id, r.review_content, r.rating, r.like_count, r.created_at,
m.mem_name, m.mem_img,
p.photo_id, p.review_id AS photo_review_id, p.file_path, p.original_name, p.img_order
FROM park_review r JOIN member m ON r.mem_id = m.mem_id LEFT JOIN review_photo p ON r.review_id = p.review_id
WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY p.img_order ASC
